scripts.build: for p in core remark markdown-it comark blueprint mdbook; do bun run --cwd "packages/$p" build || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:packages: for p in typst.ts core remark markdown-it comark blueprint; do (cd packages/$p && publint --strict) || exit 1; done
scripts.pack: for p in typst.ts core remark markdown-it comark blueprint mdbook; do (cd packages/$p && bun pm pack --destination ../../packs --quiet) || exit 1; done
